reasons: The inserted sentence supplies every preferred atomic element: professional and workmanlike services, an express 90-day services conformance period, a 12-month software/deliverable conformance period, no malicious code, compliance with laws, and repair/replacement/refund remedies.

Contrary to the deterministic check flagging the 90-day services period, the operative text states it expressly ("for a period of ninety (90) days following performance, will conform to their documentation") and uses unqualified "conform" rather than a materiality qualifier.

The original clause warranted only Y2K date handling, so a concise insertion for the absent performance warranty is minimal; no untouched sentence, disclaimer, or Y2K obligation was altered and no undefined term or dangling mechanic was introduced.
Refund is scoped to "fees paid for the non-conforming" items, which is a customer-favourable, narrowly drawn remedy and requires no further redline.
